**[Title]**
ANAK PUNK INDONESIA

**[Transition]**
FADE IN:

* * *

**[Scene 1] — TROTOAR KOTA, MALAM HARI (10 detik)**
EXT. TROTOAR KOTA — MALAM HARI. Lampu jalan redup, trotoar basah sisa hujan. Seorang pria berjaket kulit lusuh penuh tambalan duduk bersandar di dinding toko tutup, memeluk gitar butut. Ia mengeluarkan foto lusuh dirinya bersama seorang wanita, menatapnya lama dengan mata sendu.

**[Dialog]**
PRIA: Aku capek... capek jadi hantu di kotaku sendiri.

**Shot list:**

1.  _Wide shot_ (0-2.5s) — trotoar sepi, pria kecil di sudut frame
    
2.  _Medium shot_ (2.5-5s) — pria duduk memeluk gitar, orang lewat blur di latar
    
3.  _Close-up_ (5-7.5s) — tangan memegang foto lusuh
    
4.  _Close-up wajah_ (7.5-10s) — mata pria menatap kosong, sedikit berkaca-kaca
    

**[Transition]**
CUT TO:

* * *

**[Scene 2] — TROTOAR KOTA, DINI HARI (10 detik)**
EXT. TROTOAR KOTA — DINI HARI MENJELANG SUBUH. Langit berubah dari hitam ke biru gelap. Pria berdiri, menatap jaket kulitnya lalu melepasnya perlahan dan melipatnya rapi di trotoar. Ia menyampirkan gitar di punggung dan mulai berjalan pergi, langkahnya pasti.

**[Dialog]**
PRIA: Aku pulang... untuk kamu.

**Shot list:**

1.  _Wide shot_ (0-2.5s) — langit subuh, siluet pria berdiri
    
2.  _Close-up_ (2.5-5s) — tangan melipat jaket kulit
    
3.  _Medium shot_ (5-7.5s) — pria menyampirkan gitar, menoleh sebentar ke jalanan
    
4.  _Tracking shot_ (7.5-10s) — pria berjalan pergi, kamera mengikuti dari belakang
    

**[Transition]**
FADE TO:

* * *

**[Scene 3] — DEPAN RUMAH KECIL, PAGI HARI (10 detik)**
EXT. DEPAN RUMAH KECIL — PAGI HARI. Matahari pagi menyinari gang sempit. Pria berdiri di depan pintu, ragu sesaat lalu mengetuk. Pintu terbuka — seorang wanita muda berdiri dengan mata berkaca-kaca. Tanpa kata, mereka berpelukan erat.

**Shot list:**

1.  _Medium shot_ (0-2.5s) — pria mengetuk pintu, ragu
    
2.  _Close-up_ (2.5-5s) — pintu terbuka, wajah wanita dari kaget jadi haru
    
3.  _Close-up_ (5-7.5s) — tangan wanita meraih pria, ekspresi lega bercampur haru
    
4.  _Wide/two-shot_ (7.5-10s) — pelukan erat, cahaya pagi dari belakang — shot penutup
    

**[Transition]**
FADE OUT.

assets.name: Pria
assets.physicalCharacteristics: He is a Southeast Asian man in his late 20s with a lean, wiry build and sun-darkened skin. His hair is styled in a messy, chin-length jet-black mullet with shaved sides, paired with a thin, unkempt goatee and a small silver hoop piercing in his left nostril. His eyes are dark brown and deep-set, featuring heavy lids and a sharp, prominent nose.
assets.clothingAccessories: He wears a heavy black faux-leather biker jacket adorned with rusted metal studs and colorful embroidered patches, over a faded charcoal grey cotton t-shirt. His lower half consists of slim-fit black denim jeans with frayed holes at the knees, secured by a silver studded belt, and scuffed black leather combat boots with thick rubber soles.
assets.backstory: He has spent several years living as a street musician and punk in Jakarta, distancing himself from his family to find his own identity. After years of hardship on the streets, he has decided to abandon the punk lifestyle to seek reconciliation with his past.
assets.sceneEvidence: Described as 'Pria berjaket kulit lusuh penuh tambalan' (Man in a worn leather jacket full of patches) carrying a 'gitar butut' (shabby guitar).

assets.name: Wanita Muda
assets.physicalCharacteristics: She is a Southeast Asian woman in her mid-20s with a soft, oval face and a warm, olive complexion. Her straight raven-black hair is pulled back into a low, neat ponytail, revealing small silver stud earrings. Her large, expressive almond-shaped eyes are dark brown and framed by thick, natural lashes.
assets.clothingAccessories: She wears a modest, floral-patterned rayon blouse in soft pastel blue and white, paired with a long, flowing navy blue cotton skirt that reaches her ankles. On her feet, she wears simple tan leather flip-flops, and her only jewelry is a thin gold wedding band on her left ring finger.
assets.backstory: She is the Pria's partner or close family member who has remained in their small hometown, holding onto hope for his eventual return. She has maintained a modest life working in the local community while waiting for him to leave the street life behind.
assets.sceneEvidence: Described as 'seorang wanita muda' (a young woman) who appears at the door of the small house in the final scene.

assets.name: Trotoar Kota
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A weathered concrete sidewalk measuring 10 feet wide with cracked surfaces and damp puddles reflecting faint yellow light. The backdrop consists of closed metal rolling shutters of shops painted in faded grey and plastered with peeling concert posters. A single rusted lamp post provides dim, flickering illumination over the coarse texture of the wet stone and the man's discarded leather jacket.
assets.timeOfDay: Night transitioning to early dawn between 11:00 PM and 4:30 AM

assets.name: Depan Rumah Kecil
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A modest house front featuring a weathered wooden door painted in a peeling teal color set into a whitewashed brick wall. A small concrete porch measuring 4 feet by 5 feet sits under a rusted corrugated metal awning that casts sharp morning shadows. To the side of the door, a few clay pots with wilted jasmine plants sit on a cracked tiled floor.
assets.timeOfDay: Morning approximately 7:00 AM with bright directional sunlight

assets.name: Gitar
assets.physicalCharacteristics: An acoustic guitar with a battered plywood body featuring a matte, sun-bleached mahogany finish and deep, splintered gashes along the lower bout. The fretboard is stained with dark grime and sweat, missing its high E string, while the headstock is chipped and adorned with peeling, water-damaged punk band stickers.

assets.name: Foto
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A four-by-six inch color print with heavy silvering and spiderweb-like creases across its glossy surface. The edges are severely frayed and yellowed from moisture, showing a grainy image of a man and woman with their faces partially obscured by a dark brown coffee stain and a vertical tear through the center.

assets.name: Gang Sempit
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A narrow residential alleyway only 5 feet wide with high walls made of exposed red brick and grey cement. The ground is a mix of uneven asphalt and dirt, cluttered with parked old bicycles and plastic water gallons near the entrances. Overhead, a tangle of black electrical wires crisscrosses against the sky, framing the path toward the small house.
assets.timeOfDay: Early morning around 7:00 AM with soft light filtering from above

frames.title: Strumming in Silence
frames.visualDescription: Pria sits alone on the steps of the Depan Rumah Kecil, cradling his Gitar. The afternoon sun casts long shadows across the porch as he looks down at his instrument with a somber expression. The weathered wood of the house frames him, emphasizing his isolation.
frames.audioDescription: The soft, melancholy sound of a single guitar string being plucked echoes. Distant city traffic hums faintly in the background, contrasting with the quiet of the residential street.
frames.motionDescription: The camera starts in a wide shot and slowly zooms in on Pria's face, capturing the subtle change in his expression.

frames.title: A Shared Memory
frames.visualDescription: Wanita Muda approaches Pria, holding a small Foto in her hand. She stands on the Trotoar Kota just in front of the house, looking toward him with a mix of hesitation and hope. Pria looks up, his attention shifting from the guitar to her.
frames.audioDescription: The sound of footsteps on the pavement stops abruptly. A light breeze rustles the nearby leaves, filling the silence between the two characters.
frames.motionDescription: An over-the-shoulder shot from behind Pria, focusing on Wanita Muda as she steps closer into the frame.

frames.title: The Conversation Begins
frames.visualDescription: Pria and Wanita Muda are now standing together near the entrance of a Gang Sempit. He has set the Gitar aside to look closely at the Foto she is showing him. Their faces are illuminated by the narrow strip of light filtering through the alleyway buildings.
frames.audioDescription: The ambient noise of the city becomes more muffled as they move into the alley. Pria speaks in a low, hushed tone, his voice carrying a hint of nostalgia.
frames.motionDescription: The camera performs a slow pan around the characters, highlighting the cramped, intimate nature of the alleyway setting.
